KP 2. Calculating the Distance Between Two Points
3.?

What is the distance between the points (−1,1) and (−3,−2)?

E
Tue, Nov 4th @ 9:25 AM|Elapsed: 0:22Correct

In this case, we have (−1,1)⏟(x1,y1) and (−3,−2)⏟(x2,y2). So, the distance d can be calculated using the distance formula, as follows:

d=(x2−x1)2+(y2−y1)2=(−3−(−1))2+(−2−1)2=(−2)2+(−3)2=4+9=13
